subject: Trial success guardrails, owners, and internal signoffs
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Arun Patel <arun@dataglow.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@dataglow.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Quick recap + proposed POC guardrails

Hi Arun / Elena —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Good high-level alignment; summarizing next steps so we have a single source of truth before we build the POC runbook. Please flag anything I missed.

Key goals (what success looks like for Dataglow):
- 95th percentile inference latency < 220ms for 512-token requests (customer workload sample)
- API throughput to support ~10 concurrent sessions at peak (simulated load)
- Semantic-quality parity: top-1 relevance >= 88% vs your current embedding-based recall (we'll run an eval set)
- No prod data leaves your VPC during the trial (privacy requirement)

POC scope & timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (this week): access & security setup, API keys, network peering checklist
- Week 1: baseline evaluation (we run standard prompts/evals against your sample dataset)
- Week 2: optimization (batching, quantization profile), run load tests
- Week 3: wrap-up, results review, and decision meeting

Owners (we'll finalize):
- Redwood POC lead: Vanessa Ortiz (me) — runbook, cadence, technical touchpoints
- Redwood runtime/infra: Ben Carter — load & latency tuning
- Customer technical lead: Arun Patel — dataset, eval set access
- Customer security/compliance: Elena Ruiz — network/KMS sign-off

Open items for you to confirm:
1) Are the success metrics above aligned with what Dataglow can measure?
2) Can your infra team grant the staging VPC peering by Wednesday (24 Feb)?
3) Any objections to the proposed 3-week cadence?

Attachments: initial POC runbook stub (dataglow-poc-runbook.pdf) and an onboarding checklist.

If that looks good I will send a formal POC plan (owners + dates) and a short hubspot playbook you can share internally.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

Attachment: dataglow-poc-runbook.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
Attachment: redwood-trial-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)
From: Arun Patel <arun@dataglow.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@dataglow.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed POC guardrails

Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear summary. We agree with the success criteria in principle; a few clarifications below:

- Latency: target looks reasonable but can we measure both cold and warm starts? We'll provide sample request traces.
- Semantic parity: we'll provide a labeled eval set (approx 600 queries) by EOD Tuesday (24 Feb).
- VPC peering: security is okay to proceed — Elena, can you confirm the timeline?

One ask: can we extend the window to 4 weeks to allow a short remediation iteration if tuning indicates regression?

Assignees: I will be the technical lead for dataset access. Elena, can you own the peering?

Happy to jump on 30-minute sync tomorrow to confirm access.

— Arun
Arun Patel
Head of ML Engineering, Dataglow
arun@dataglow.com

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@dataglow.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Arun Patel <arun@dataglow.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed POC guardrails

> Vanessa —
>
> Thanks for the clear summary. We agree with the success criteria in principle; a few clarifications below:
>

> - Semantic parity: we'll provide a labeled eval set (approx 600 queries) by EOD Tuesday (24 Feb).

Vanessa / team —
We can do peering by Thursday (26 Feb) if you provide the subnet ranges and the required firewall rules today. I will coordinate with infra. Also note our compliance team wants to see a short network diagram and KMS key flow before we sign off.

Elena Ruiz
Senior InfoSec Manager, Dataglow
elena@dataglow.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Arun Patel <arun@dataglow.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@dataglow.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 14:48:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: approving POC timeline + potential credit/discount ask

Marissa / Ben / Rishi —

Looping you in as we finalize dates with Dataglow. They want 1 additional week (4-week POC) to allow remediation iteration. Key asks for internal review:

- Can we approve 1 week of trial credit (estimate $3.2k GPU cost) to keep the deal moving?
- If we need to provide quantization-assisted tuning (engineer time), what's the resourcing impact?
- Any compliance docs we should prep besides the network diagram & KMS flow?

I've attached the draft runbook. I recommend approving the extension and the small credit to avoid delaying customer timelines — they are a strategic mid-market target.

Thanks,
Vanessa

Attachment: dataglow-poc-runbook.pdf (updated v2)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Arun Patel <arun@dataglow.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@dataglow.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: POC plan (final) + weekly kickoff & 5 quick asks before Monday

Hi Arun / Elena —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per internal approvals we've agreed to the 4-week timeline and are offering one week of trial credits. Attached is the final POC plan (dataglow-poc-runbook.pdf) which includes owners, daily checkpoints, and the evaluation rubric. Key items for this coming week (please confirm owners/ETA):

1) Share subnet ranges + firewall requirements (Dataglow infra) — due Mon 02/29
2) Upload labeled eval set to the shared Drive (Arun) — due Mon 02/29
3) Sign the connectivity attestation / KMS flow doc (Elena) — due Tue 03/01
4) Redwood to provision staging keys and provide API ingress endpoints (Vanessa / Ben) — done by Tue 03/01
5) Quick kickoff: Wed 03/02 10:00 AM PT (30m) — confirm if that works

If the above holds, we'll run the baseline eval Wed-Fri next week and follow with two weeks of tuning + one week of remediation and final review.

Small note on measurement: we've attached poc-success-metrics.csv with the exact KPI definitions we'll be using so your team can precompute baseline numbers.

Please reply with confirmations for 1–3 and the kickoff time.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
